releases.title: Initial Release
releases.summary: First public release of Anvil — catch architecture boundary violations and AI anti-patterns at save time, not at code review.

entries.title: File analysis
entries.description: Run `anvil check` on any file to detect architecture violations and anti-patterns.

entries.title: Git-aware checking
entries.description: Analyse only changed, staged, or recently modified files with `--changed`, `--staged`, and `--since` flags.

entries.title: Watch mode
entries.description: Get real-time feedback on file changes with `anvil watch --source`.

entries.title: Fast feedback
entries.description: Parallel analysis with intelligent caching delivers results in under 2 seconds.

entries.title: Architecture boundary detection
entries.description: Automatic baseline inference catches new cross-boundary dependencies as they're introduced.

entries.title: 7 AI escape-hatch patterns
entries.description: Detects explicit `any` types, `@ts-ignore` directives, broad `eslint-disable`, empty catch blocks, and console logging in production code.

entries.title: Suppression with accountability
entries.description: Suppress warnings using `@anvil-ignore` with mandatory explanations and optional time-boxing.

entries.title: Configurable severity
entries.description: Set severity levels per pattern to match your team's standards.

entries.title: Interactive setup wizard
entries.description: Run `anvil init` for a guided TUI setup experience.

entries.title: GitHub Action
entries.description: Add Anvil checks to your pull request workflow with built-in PR comment annotations and status checks.

entries.title: Save-time detection
entries.description: Anti-pattern detection triggers on file save with sub-100ms feedback.

entries.title: Architecture gate tree view
entries.description: Browse architecture gate results directly in the VS Code sidebar.

entries.title: Remediation hints
entries.description: Policy failures include actionable hints with click-to-navigate for all violation types.

entries.title: Diagnostics panel
entries.description: All violations surface in the standard VS Code diagnostics panel alongside your other tools.

entries.title: Dependency vulnerability fixes
entries.description: Resolved known vulnerabilities in tar, lodash, undici, and diff via pnpm overrides.

items.title: Explain warnings
items.description: Deep-dive into any warning with `anvil explain <id>`.

items.title: Drift tracking
items.description: Capture architecture snapshots, compare over time, and visualise trends.

items.title: OPA architecture policies
items.description: Define architecture rules in YAML with full OPA/Rego integration.

items.title: Architecture templates
items.description: Pre-built templates for Layered, Hexagonal, Clean, and DDD architectures.

items.title: Remote policy bundles
items.description: Share and enforce policies across teams with remote bundle support.

items.title: llms.txt export
items.description: Export architecture rules in llms.txt format so AI coding tools understand your boundaries.

items.title: Copilot & Cursor rules
items.description: Generate context rules for GitHub Copilot and Cursor from your Anvil configuration.

items.title: MCP tool server
items.description: Expose Anvil analysis as an MCP tool for use in AI agent workflows.
